review_candidates.title: Lead IT Business Applications Analyst
review_candidates.description: About Advanced Energy Advanced Energy (Nasdaq: AEIS) is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of highly engineered, precision power conversion, measurement and control solutions for mission-critical applications and processes. AE’s power solutions enable customer innovation in complex applications for a wide range of industries including semiconductor equipment, industrial, manufacturing, telecommunications, data center computing and healthcare. Advanced Energy has devoted four decades to perfecting power for its global customers and is headquartered in Denver, Colorado. WHY BE A PART OF ADVANCED ENERGY? Some people say it’s like working in the best of two worlds. We operate like an agile, growing, small company – you can see your work make a difference to the company every day. Things move quickly and you can see and feel it. At the same time, we’re a global company founded in 1981 and have been publicly traded for more than 28 years. We have a strong cash position, deep trust and partnership with leading customers, a global best-in-class operations capability, and a proven leadership team. We have a track record and resources to make things happen both organically and inorganically. Being part of a nimble company with a solid foundation attracts team members that are capable, driven and like a challenge. Our employees collaborate and know how to have fun inventing, working, building and winning together. At our core, we are Advanced Energy – powering the future, together. Position Summary The SAP MM/ eWMS Business Analyst is responsible for leading the design, configuration, implementation, and support of SAP MM/ eWMS (Extended Warehouse Management System) solutions. This role ensures the optimization of warehouse operations, integration with SAP S/4HANA and related business systems, and the delivery of best-in-class warehouse management processes. Responsibilities Analyze and define business requirements in collaboration with the user community, identifying functionality gaps and recommending best practice solutions. Create process flows and detailed solution designs to support business objectives. Lead the design, configuration, testing, and training of business processes related to SAP MM, eWMS, S/4HANA warehouse modules, and related business systems, ensuring enhancements and improvements align with organizational goals. Integrate warehouse automation technologies such as robotics, handhelds, scanners, AGVs/AGRs, and other advanced systems to optimize warehouse operations for efficiency, scalability, and usability. Collaborate with development teams on RICEFS objects (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms, and Scripts) to deliver robust and scalable solutions. Analyze, debug, and maintain SAP and related solutions to ensure correct and efficient operations, supporting both SAP ERP and associated business applications. Map business processes using tools such as Microsoft Visio, SmartSheet, or equivalent, and prepare functional documentation, test scripts, and end-user training materials. Participate in project management and team leadership activities, taking responsibility for the completion of individual or team tasks as assigned by the project manager or supervisor. Perform all work in accordance with defined IT and compliance processes, ensuring adherence to organizational standards and regulatory requirements. Pursue ongoing training and professional development to enhance knowledge of warehouse management, SAP solutions, and specific business functional areas. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. SAP certifications in MM/ WMS/eWMS or related modules. Experience in project management or team leadership roles. Minimum of 10 years of hands-on experience with SAP MM, WMS (centralized or decentralized) or S/4HANA eWMS. Demonstrated expertise in the design, configuration, testing, and training of SAP MM/ eWMS modules. Experience integrating warehouse automation and technology solutions. Proven track record in supporting SAP ERP systems and associated business applications. Strong skills in business process mapping and use of process documentation tools. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams. Demonstrated ability to solve complex problems and deliver innovative solutions. Proven capability to work productively within a team-oriented and fast-paced environment. SAP certifications (SAP S/4HANA MM, EWM, SAP ERP WM, SAP S/4HANA LE-WM, SAP S/4HANA BPI, etc.)

review_candidates.title: Junior Salesforce / CRM Administrator - Semarang
review_candidates.description: We are looking for... Hopefully, you! We're hiring a motivated and detail-oriented Junior Salesforce / CRM Administrator to join our Technology team in Semarang. You'll own day-to-day administration of our Salesforce environment — user setup, access, configuration, data quality and small enhancements — working closely with our Technology team and external technology partner in Australia and supporting our local Indonesian team on the ground. This is a deliberate junior role. We're hiring for curiosity and craft over years on a CV. If you've been working through Trailhead, hold (or are close to) your Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201), and want a clear runway into senior admin — read on. Junior Salesforce / CRM Administrator's key responsibilities will include: Salesforce administration: user setup, profiles, roles, permission sets and record type assignments; objects, fields, validation rules, flows, approval processes, saved reports and dashboards Data hygiene: imports (CSV via Data Loader), exports, deduplication and clean-up across Salesforce and (with guidance) NetSuite User support and training: triage and resolve support tickets, deliver short training sessions, and write simple how-to guides that drive adoption Documentation: keep our system docs, SOPs and admin guides current and useful Testing: participate in UAT for Salesforce releases, sandbox refreshes, and small enhancements Cross-system curiosity: learn how Salesforce talks to NetSuite, our website and middleware — we'll teach you the integration side as you go Reporting and dashboards: build and maintain reports and dashboards that give the sales and ops teams clear visibility of pipeline and performance Local IT support: help the Semarang team with day-to-day IT issues when needed Requirements We need you to bring... Excellent English — written and verbal. You'll be working daily with our Australian team 1+ year hands-on with Salesforce in an admin, support, business analyst or consulting capacity. Internships, capstone projects and serious self-study portfolios count — tell us what you've actually built Salesforce Administrator certification (ADM 201) (or actively working towards it). We'll fund your next cert once you're in role. Core CRM concepts — lead-to-opportunity, sales stages, forecasting, account and contact management. You don't need deep sales operations knowledge, but you need to be comfortable talking to sales teams Curiosity about multi-system environments — CRM, ERP, website, middleware. You don't need experience with NetSuite or integrations; you do need to be interested in how the pieces fit together Structured, detail-minded approach to data and configuration, with strong problem-solving and clear communication Familiarity with Agile or Kanban ways of working is a plus, not a must Eager to grow — we're looking for someone who wants to be a senior Salesforce admin or consultant in 2-3 years Please note that we require full permanent working rights for this position. Benefits In return, we'll give you... Perks, benefits and the space to grow. We offer a competitive salary, a comprehensive benefits package and plenty of opportunities for career growth and development. This includes: The opportunities you need to grow, develop and craft a career you're proud of within the global Eco Outdoor business Company-sponsored events and activities to connect with your colleagues The opportunity to give back via our internal Social Housing and Sustainability initiatives OK, you want to know what you're getting yourself into? Let us introduce ourselves . Established in 2001 by expert minds from the landscape design and construction industries, Eco Outdoor is an Australian-founded global brand with showrooms in Australia, New Zealand and North America. We're constantly experimenting, innovating and pushing creative boundaries, delivering the highest-quality natural stone and architectural surfaces (and outdoor furniture collections) to the international architecture market. We employ around 130 people across the globe, all of whom are dedicated to innovating, crafting and providing remarkable products and unbelievable hospitality to our clients and collaborators in the architecture and design space. We thrive on constant reinvention, regular development opportunities and a passionate culture grounded in connection and involvement. We're a tribe of collaborators, critical thinkers, problem-solvers and challenge-embracers, and we nurture our incredibly talented people to put their best foot forward every day. That starts with our core values - Be a Game Changer, Only Accept Awesome, Play as a Team, Be Curious, Get Fired up - which are deeply ingrained in our culture. Basically, we're all about fostering an innovative, industry-leading, collaborative, creative, passionate team to reach their fullest potential. That's good for humans and good for business. If this sounds like your kind of gig... We'd love to hear from you. If you need more information before you apply, check out our website, LinkedIn or Instagram. If you have questions those sites don't answer, flick us a line at people@ecooutdoor.com.au unless you're a recruitment agency, in which case: no, thanks. We've got this one covered.

Responsibilities For This Position ROLE AND POSITION OBJECTIVES: General Dynamics Mission Systems is seeking an experienced Integrated Product Team (IPT) Lead to support sustainment of the US Navy Ohio Class Fire Control System. The IPT Lead will be responsible for leading a cross-functional team in the planning, execution, and delivery of Basic Order Agreement (BOA) projects in support of operational requirements. We encourage you to apply if you have any of these preferred skills or experiences: Familiarity with Electronic Test equipment Lead and manage an Integrated Product Team (IPT) across engineering, program management, contracts, logistics, and supply chain functions Coordinate the planning and execution in alignment with BOA contractual requirements Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders regarding BOA projects Develop and maintain program schedules, budgets, and performance metrics Identify and mitigate program risks and issues Ensure compliance with contractual obligations and technical requirements Facilitate IPT meetings, reviews, and status reporting Collaborate with engineering teams to assess obsolescence and identify refresh solutions Support proposal and BOA task order activities as needed Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation What sets you apart: Success leading the systems development life cycle with strong proficiency with requirements management and system modeling tools Creative thinker motivated to apply technical standards and methodologies to develop solutions Collaborative team player with the ability to provide technical leadership and position others for success Strong presentation and communications skills with experience in the art of negotiation and the ability to meet challenging customer requirements with win-win solutions Commitment to ongoing professional development for yourself and others Identifies opportunities to apply AI for continuous improvement and innovation Our Commitment to You: An exciting career path with opportunities for continuous learning and development. Research oriented work, alongside award winning teams developing practical solutions for our nation’s security Flexible schedules with every other Friday off work, if desired (9/80 schedule) Competitive benefits, including 401k matching, flex time off, paid parental leave, healthcare benefits, health & wellness programs, employee resource and social groups, and more See more at gdmissionsystems.com/careers/why-work-for-us/benefits Workplace Options: This position is fully on-site. This estimate represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors (geographic location, etc.). Actual pay may vary. This job posting will remain open until the position is filled. Company Overview General Dynamics Mission Systems (GDMS) engineers a diverse portfolio of high technology solutions, products and services that enable customers to successfully execute missions across all domains of operation. With a global team of 12,000+ top professionals, we partner with the best in industry to expand the bounds of innovation in the defense and scientific arenas. Given the nature of our work and who we are, we value trust, honesty, alignment and transparency. We offer highly competitive benefits and pride ourselves in being a great place to work with a shared sense of purpose. You will also enjoy a flexible work environment where contributions are recognized and rewarded. If who we are and what we do resonates with you, we invite you to join our high-performance team! Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans

review_candidates.title: Infra Strategy Manager
review_candidates.description: 함께하게 될 팀에 대해 알려드려요 토스의 인프라는 서버, 네트워크, IDC, 클라우드처럼 전문성이 다른 팀들이 함께 만들어요. 각 팀이 자기 영역을 깊게 파고드는 만큼, 팀 경계를 넘는 과제를 하나의 관점으로 엮는 일도 중요해졌어요. 토스의 여러 계열사는 각자 인프라를 운영하면서도 IDC와 기술 자산을 함께 써요. 그래서 계열사 전체가 공통 기준 위에서 인프라를 운영하고 발전시키도록 만드는 일이 인프라 전략의 큰 축이에요. Infra Strategy Team은 인프라 전체를 보며 이런 과제를 정의하고 해결하는 팀이에요. 인프라 내 여러 팀은 물론 보안·데이터·서비스 조직과도 거버넌스와 기술 과제를 함께 풀어가요. Infra Strategy Manager는 팀원을 두고 관리하는 역할이 아니라, 여러 조직에 걸친 문제의 오너가 되는 역할이에요. 방향을 조율하는 데서 멈추지 않고, 기술 의사결정을 직접 내리며 실행 결과까지 책임져요. 이런 커리어를 그려볼 수 있어요 자체 IDC와 GPU 인프라, 프라이빗 클라우드를 모두 가진 환경에서 인프라를 어디에 어떻게 두고 키울지 설계하고, 실제 투자·구축·서비스 전환까지 이끌어요. 한 팀, 한 법인을 넘어 계열사를 아우르는 인프라 표준·소싱·감사체계를 세우고, GPU·프라이빗 클라우드의 기술 방향까지 함께 만들어볼 수 있어요. 만들어낸 성과를 바탕으로 더 넓은 인프라 전략과 핵심 과제를 리드하며, 해결하는 문제의 범위와 영향력을 넓혀갈 수 있어요. 합류하면 함께 할 업무예요 인프라 전반에서 풀어야 할 문제를 직접 찾고 해결 목표와 방향을 정의해요. 인프라 리더십과 과제의 목표·우선순위·의사결정 범위를 맞추고, 관련 조직과 역할·리소스·일정을 정리해요. 기술적 트레이드오프를 판단해 필요한 의사결정을 내려요. 여러 조직의 합의가 필요하면 대안과 근거를 정리해 결정을 이끌어요. 실행 중 생기는 조직 간 이견과 장애물을 풀고, 실제 구축과 도입으로 이어져 목표한 성과가 날 때까지 책임져요. 이런 과제들을 풀어나가요 인프라 거버넌스 조직과 계열사마다 다른 인프라 기술 스펙과 구성을 공통 기준으로 표준화하고, 실제 도입과 전환까지 이끌어요. 흩어져 있는 인프라 소싱을 하나로 묶어요. 서버·네트워크·GPU처럼 규모가 큰 자산은 계열사의 수요와 기술 요건을 모아 공동 소싱을 추진하고, 협상력과 조달 효율을 높여요. 여러 계열사에 공통으로 필요한 인프라 기술을 공동 개발 과제로 정의하고, 개발 주체와 역할 분담, 결과물의 활용·운영 방식을 설계해요. 인프라 서비스 수준 협약(SLA)과 감사·점검 체계를 수립하고 운영을 주도해요. 계열사 간 인프라 위수탁의 책임 범위와 점검 기준도 명확히 해요. 인프라 의사결정을 다루는 공동 거버넌스 체계를 만들어요. 의사결정 주체와 절차를 정리하고, 논의가 결정과 실행으로 이어지도록 운영해요. 인프라 용량과 수요, 비용 구조를 가시화하고, 이를 근거로 투자 우선순위와 자원 배분 방향을 정해요. IDC 로드맵과 인프라 중장기 계획을 세우고, 실제 투자·구축으로 이어지도록 이끌어요. 크로스팀 기술 과제 GPU 인프라의 사양과 도입·운영에 필요한 인증 요건을 정의하고, 자체 IDC와 퍼블릭 클라우드를 아우르는 배치 전략을 세워 추진해요. We're hiring a Project and Implementation Manager who can run the engineering plan on Monday and stand in a facility with the nursing staff on Thursday. Inside the company, you're the project manager across engineering, keeping the plan honest and releases on the dates we promised. Out in the field, you lead rollouts of the MaxiCare EMR into skilled nursing and assisted living facilities, from kickoff through go live. What you see on the floor of a building shapes what engineering builds next, and you keep that loop tight. MaxiCare Offers the Following Unlimited vacation: We don't count days. Take the time you need to rest and come back sharp, coordinated with your team so the work keeps moving. Career growth: MaxiCare is an AI first company, and this seat puts your hands on how one gets built. You'll work every day inside sophisticated product design where AI is part of the architecture, the workflow, and the product itself, and you'll build the skills the next decade of software will run on. Holiday gathering: Once a year the whole team comes together in person to celebrate the year and spend time together away from the screen. Health and fitness: We cover 50 percent of a monthly fitness and health club membership. Details are discussed during the interview process. Compensation: Competitive base compensation calibrated to the experience you bring and the market in your jurisdiction, plus performance based annual bonus participation. Specifics are discussed during the interview process. Remote: Fully remote within the United States, with regular travel to facilities. Cameras stay on for every video call. Reports to the Director of Product Management. Full time, exempt. Responsibilities Engineering Project Management Run project plans for engineering work across the platform, tracking scope, dependencies, risks, and dates in Jira Run the cadence meetings that keep work moving, and surface slips early enough to act on them Coordinate release readiness with engineering, product, and QA so nothing reaches a facility as a surprise Facility Rollouts Lead each implementation from contract signature through go live: rollout plan, configuration, data migration checkpoints, user setup, training, and cutover Travel to facilities for kickoffs, training, and go live, and stay until the building is running on MaxiCare Work side by side with administrators, directors of nursing, MDS coordinators, business office managers, and floor staff Communication and Risk Keep facility leadership, our executive team, and engineering informed with clear status reports Own the issue log and escalations, and know which problems can wait until after go live and which cannot Playbooks Build and maintain the implementation playbook, checklists, and templates Improve them after every rollout so each facility goes live faster than the last Education A four year college degree from an accredited institution. Experience Ten or more years as a project manager, with a record of delivering complex projects on schedule A background in skilled nursing or assisted living facility management and operations: census, admissions, MDS, care plans, and billing Experience leading software rollouts into facilities from kickoff through go live, ideally an EMR or other clinical system Experience running project plans with software engineering teams, including sprints, backlogs, and releases Hands on Jira and Confluence Native English language proficiency for training sessions, go live meetings, and status calls Daily comfort with AI tools, Anthropic Claude in particular Willingness to travel to facilities regularly, sometimes on short notice Authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available. Preferred Prior role as a nursing home administrator, executive director, assistant administrator, or operations lead in an SNF or ALF PMP, PMI ACP, or a comparable project management certification Experience with PointClickCare, MatrixCare, or other long term care EMRs, including moving facilities off them Data migration and cutover planning for a clinical system Familiarity with CMS requirements, PDPM, and state survey expectations as they affect go live planning Experience at an early stage software company Travel Regular travel to skilled nursing and assisted living facilities for rollouts, training, and go live support, plus occasional on site team meetings where we work through product design and architecture strategy together. Some trips will come up on short notice. How to Apply Along with your resume, tell us about a facility rollout you led and a project you ran with an engineering team, what went wrong on each, and how you handled it. Apply here on LinkedIn or at maxicare.io. We read every application.
